messages:
paula: Quick idea Can we trial a floor-by-floor 'Flag of Thanks' installation for the month? small fabric pennants with 1-line shoutouts hung on string in break areas. visual + low-effort.
devon: Love that. Logistically we need fabric pennants, safe hanging method (no nails), volunteer assembly, and building sign-off for common area decor.
harpreet: Ops can cut fabric and heat-seal edges in-house. Suggest using clothespins on removable command hooks to avoid drilling.
facilities-bot: Heads-up: anything hung in corridors needs Facilities approval & fire-safety check. No items can block egress or emergency signage. Approval turnaround ~3 business days.
paula: Good call. I'll submit a facilities request today. Also thinking of a 1-week pilot on floor 5 to prove the process.
devon: Budget ballpark: fabric + fabric markers $90, clothespins & command hooks $25, printing small instruction tags $12, shipping/incidentals $18 = ~$145. ok?
finance: That spend is fine under Culture activations. Use EVENTS_DECOR and attach receipts.
harpreet: Volunteer plan: 2 assembly shifts (Tue evening 6-8pm) to write notes + mount pennants; 1 morning set-up shift day-of. Who can help?
paula: I can do Tue evening and morning setup. I'll draft short copy for the instruction tag: "Write 1 sentence about someone who helped you — peg it up. Optional anonymity."
devon: Also propose a QR on the tag linking to a digital form for remote folks and folks who prefer typed submissions. I'll generate the QR and mock it on the tag.
hr-bot: HR note: ensure participation is opt-in and include an opt-out contact. Avoid wording tied to performance. Keep entries non-evaluative.
paula: Noted. We'll include: "Optional / anonymous entries welcome. For opt-out, DM @paula."
facilities-bot: ACTION: submit location sketch and egress check by Fri noon to get approval for next-week pilot.
harpreet: For materials: I can source pre-cut pennant blanks locally and bring markers. If we need a branded look, vendor lead time is 7 business days for custom print; in-house is same-week.
devon: Let's go in-house for pilot to move fast. If pilot goes well, order custom printed pennants for Q4.
paula: Volunteer signup idea: 6 slots Tue night for writing + 3 people Wed morning setup. I'll post a signup link.
paula: Also idea: take a single photo after setup and collect 2 quotes from participants for a micro internal post. keep it tasteful and anonymous if people prefer.
finance: Please log receipts and tag the spend. Also capture headcount for reporting.
hr-bot: Accessibility note: place the string at an accessible height and ensure volunteers can transcribe dictations for folks who want to speak their note. Add that to instruction tag.
harpreet: I'll bring a small step stool for safe reach and gloves for handling. Also will prep a small box for postcards if some want to drop longer notes.
devon: Quick checklist: facilities request (paula), materials list and in-house sourcing (harpreet), volunteer signup (paula), QR/digital form (devon), HR opt-out language (paula). I'll follow up on the QR mock.
paula: Great. If Facilities approves quickly we'll run the pilot next Wed. I'll update thread with the signup link and the final instruction tag copy. Thanks team! :small_blue_diamond:
